summary: Iteration 2 (MSG91 demo fallback + OTP resend + HelplineCard) fully verified. Backend: 16/16 new pytest tests PASSED (auth/config sms_enabled=false + demo_otp=123456 + resend_cooldown=30, phone normalization for '9999999996' / '+91 9999999996' / '09999999996' / '91-9999999996' / '+91-9999999996', invalid '12345' rejected with Hindi detail, wrong OTP -> 400 'गलत OTP', +919999999996 verified as Amit Sharma subscriber, new user signup with random 6-9 starting 10-digit + name, and regression role-routing for team/admin/super_admin). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): otp-hint on login shows 'Demo OTP: 123456' (after auth/config load). After request-otp, OTP screen otp-sub shows '+91 9999999996 · Demo OTP 123456 दर्ज करें' and resend-otp-btn text is 'OTP फिर से भेजें (30s)' with aria-disabled=true; countdown decrements 30->27 in 3s, confirming timer works. Entering wrong 000000 shows 'गलत OTP' toast. Correct 123456 lands on subscriber home which shows helpline-card with helpline-call-btn (Call) and helpline-whatsapp-btn (WhatsApp) — both pressable. Profile tab also renders helpline-card with both buttons. Regression: team (9999999997) routed to /assigned, admin (9999999998) routed to /overview correctly.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking, carried over from iteration_1.

action_items: None blocking. Optional (carry-over): migrate deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents style props to boxShadow/style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_phone() correctly strips +, spaces, dashes, leading 91 (12-digit) and leading 0 (11-digit); regex [6-9]\d{9} enforced.
uses_mock_otp() short-circuits when SMS_ENABLED is False (current .env state) so ALL numbers -> demo OTP 123456 as required.
Resend cooldown (_otp_last_sent 30s) only applied when NOT using mock OTP — so demo path allows unlimited retries, matching client-side countdown UX.
verify_otp mutates body.phone to normalized digits before DB lookup — ensures '+91 9999999996' still finds seeded 'Amit Sharma'.
HelplineCard uses Linking.openURL('tel:...') and 'https://wa.me/91...' — will work on native; on web tel: is best-effort, but buttons are pressable.
otp.tsx: resend button correctly disabled while cooldown>0 || resending; countdown reset to 30 on resend success.
index.tsx: authConfig() called only when NOT logged in (after loadAuth) — good.
Existing carryover: chat.tsx still lacks auth-gate for deep-link (from iteration_1) — not part of this iteration.
